# 2. SOURCE-OF-TRUTH RULE

The three images above are the **visual source of truth**.

Antigravity must compare its implementation against these images and reproduce:

- exact overall composition
- header height
- content widths
- horizontal and vertical spacing
- typography scale
- text wrapping
- colors
- button dimensions
- border radius
- borders
- shadows
- icons
- background treatment
- section heights
- footer
- form dimensions
- alignment
- responsive behavior

Do NOT redesign the UI.

Do NOT replace it with a generic dashboard.

Do NOT use the screenshots as `<img>` elements for the actual page.

Build the page from HTML/CSS/components.

<main class="auth-page register-page">

  <div class="auth-background"></div>

  </header>

  <div class="registration-layout">

    <section class="registration-marketing">

      <h1>
        Partnering<br>
        for a Transparent<br>
        and Efficient India
      </h1>

      <div class="orange-line"></div>

      <p>
        BIDSETU enables vendors to participate<br>
        in government procurement with<br>
        simplified documentation and<br>
        AI-powered compliance verification.
      </p>

      <blockquote>
        “Building trust between<br>
        government and industry<br>
        through technology.”
      </blockquote>

      <div class="fair-values">
        Fair &nbsp; | &nbsp; Transparent &nbsp; | &nbsp; Accountable
      </div>

    </section>

    <section class="registration-card">

      <div class="auth-brand">
        <strong>BIDSETU</strong>
        <span>
          AI-Powered Procurement Compliance<br>
          & Risk Intelligence Platform
        </span>
      </div>

      <h2>Create your vendor account</h2>
      <p class="auth-subtitle">
        Join BIDSETU to participate in government tenders.
      </p>

      <form>

        <h3>Organization Information</h3>

        <div class="form-grid two-columns">

          <div class="field">
            <label>Organization Name *</label>
            <input placeholder="Enter organization name">
          </div>

          <div class="field">
            <label>Organization Type *</label>
            <select>
              <option>Select type</option>
            </select>
          </div>

        </div>

        <div class="field">
          <label>Registration / Identification Number *</label>
          <input placeholder="Enter registration number">
        </div>

        <div class="field">
          <label>Business Address *</label>
          <input placeholder="Enter full address">
        </div>

        <div class="form-grid three-columns">

          <div class="field">
            <label>City *</label>
            <input placeholder="Enter city">
          </div>

          <div class="field">
            <label>State *</label>
            <select>
              <option>Select state</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          <div class="field">
            <label>PIN Code *</label>
            <input placeholder="Enter PIN code">
          </div>

        </div>

        <hr>

        <h3>Primary Contact</h3>

        <div class="form-grid two-columns">

          <div class="field">
            <label>Full Name *</label>
            <input placeholder="Enter full name">
          </div>

          <div class="field">
            <label>Official Email Address *</label>
            <input placeholder="you@organization.gov.in">
          </div>

        </div>

        <div class="field phone-field">
          <label>Phone Number *</label>
          <div>
            <span>+91</span>
            <input placeholder="Enter phone number">
          </div>
        </div>

        <hr>

        <h3>Account Security</h3>

        <div class="form-grid two-columns">

          <div class="field password-field">
            <label>Password *</label>
            <input type="password" placeholder="Create a password">
            <button type="button" aria-label="Show password">◉</button>
          </div>

          <div class="field password-field">
            <label>Confirm Password *</label>
            <input type="password" placeholder="Confirm your password">
            <button type="button" aria-label="Show password">◉</button>
          </div>

        </div>

        <label class="terms">
          <input type="checkbox">
          I agree to the <a href="/terms">Terms of Use</a>
          and <a href="/privacy">Privacy Policy</a> *
        </label>

        <button class="btn btn-primary submit-registration">
          Create Vendor Account <span>→</span>
        </button>

      </form>

    </section>

    <aside class="registration-features">

      <article>
        <span>▤</span>
        <div>

      </article>

      <article>

# 7. CORE CSS

Use the following as the base design system, then tune it against the embedded screenshots.

```css
:root {
  --navy: #0b426d;
  --navy-dark: #083655;
  --blue: #0b5f96;
  --blue-hover: #084f7e;

  --text: #173957;
  --muted: #63778b;

  --white: #ffffff;
  --surface: #f6fafd;
  --surface-blue: #edf6fc;

  --border: #d7e1e9;

  --orange: #f39a21;
  --green: #229b68;
  --purple: #7562d8;

  --radius-sm: 5px;
  --radius-md: 9px;
  --radius-lg: 14px;

  --shadow-card:
    0 10px 30px rgba(25, 55, 80, 0.13);

  --container: 1400px;
}

* {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

body {
  margin: 0;
  font-family:
    Inter,
    "Segoe UI",
    Roboto,
    Arial,
    sans-serif;

  color: var(--text);
  background: var(--white);
}

a {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
}

button,
input,
select {
  font: inherit;
}

.page-container {
  width: min(calc(100% - 96px), var(--container));
  margin-inline: auto;
}

/* HEADER */

.site-header {
  height: 74px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;

  padding: 0 70px;

  background: #fff;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #edf1f4;

  position: relative;
  z-index: 20;
}

.header-brand {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 20px;
}

.government-brand {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
}

.government-brand img {
  width: 52px;
  height: 58px;
  object-fit: contain;
}

.bidsetu-logo {
  font-size: 31px;
  line-height: 1;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -1px;
  color: var(--navy);
}

.bidsetu-subtitle {
  margin-top: 6px;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.35;
  color: var(--text);
}

.main-nav {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 28px;
  font-size: 14px;
}

.main-nav a {
  color: #36536d;
  position: relative;
}

.main-nav a.active {
  color: var(--navy);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.main-nav a.active::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  bottom: -25px;
  width: 30px;
  height: 3px;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  background: var(--navy);
}

.login-button {
  min-width: 120px;
  height: 46px;

  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;

  color: white !important;
  background: var(--blue);

  border-radius: 7px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* HERO */

.hero {
  position: relative;
  min-height: 372px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #edf6fc;
}

.hero-background,
.auth-background {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 0;

  background-image:
    linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      rgba(244, 249, 253, .98) 0%,
      rgba(244, 249, 253, .90) 36%,
      rgba(244, 249, 253, .48) 70%,
      rgba(244, 249, 253, .70) 100%
    ),
    url("/assets/government-building.jpg");

  background-position: center;
  background-size: cover;
}

.hero-content {
  min-height: 372px;

  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;

  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
}

.hero-copy {
  max-width: 650px;
}

.hero-copy h1 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: clamp(40px, 4vw, 57px);
  line-height: 1.02;
  letter-spacing: -1.8px;
  color: var(--navy);
}

.hero-copy p {
  max-width: 590px;
  margin: 17px 0 18px;

  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.48;
  color: #526a80;
}

.hero-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 16px;
}

.btn {
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 0 29px;

  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 10px;

  border-radius: 6px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;

  transition:
    background .18s ease,
    border-color .18s ease,
    transform .18s ease;
}

.btn:hover {
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.btn-primary {
  color: #fff;
  background: var(--blue);
  border: 1px solid var(--blue);
}

.btn-primary:hover {
  background: var(--blue-hover);
}

.btn-secondary {
  color: var(--navy);
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid var(--blue);
}

.trust-items {
  display: flex;
  margin-top: 26px;
  color: #61768a;
  font-size: 14px;
}

.trust-items > div {
  padding: 0 18px;
  border-right: 1px solid #d3dfe7;
}

.trust-items > div:first-child {
  padding-left: 0;
}

.trust-items > div:last-child {
  border-right: 0;
}

.hero-side-copy {
  align-self: flex-start;
  margin-top: 82px;
  margin-right: 40px;

  text-align: center;
  color: var(--navy);
  font-family: Georgia, serif;
  font-size: 20px;
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.tricolor-accent {
  width: 78px;
  height: 4px;
  margin: 15px auto 0;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      var(--orange) 0 48%,
      var(--green) 48% 100%
    );
}

/* FEATURE STRIPS */

.feature-strip {
  display: grid;
  position: relative;
}

.primary-features {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
  min-height: 105px;
  background: #fff;
}

.secondary-features {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  min-height: 108px;
  background: var(--surface-blue);
}

.feature {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 18px;
  padding: 20px 30px;
  border-right: 1px solid #dbe3e9;
}

.feature:last-child {
  border-right: 0;
}

.feature-icon {
  flex: 0 0 56px;
  width: 56px;
  height: 56px;

  display: grid;
  place-items: center;

  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #edf7ff;

  color: var(--blue);
  font-size: 25px;
}

.feature h3 {
  margin: 0 0 7px;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--navy);
}

.feature p {
  margin: 0;
  max-width: 210px;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  color: #667b8e;
}

/* LOWER HOME */

.lower-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.55fr 1fr .85fr;
  min-height: 265px;
}

.lower-grid > section {
  padding: 22px 25px;
  border-right: 1px solid #dce4ea;
}

.lower-grid > section:last-child {
  border-right: 0;
}

.section-heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.section-heading h2 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 19px;
  color: var(--navy);
}

.section-heading a {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #0871b9;
}

.process {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-top: 27px;
}

.process-step {
  width: 120px;
  text-align: center;
  position: relative;
}

.step-number {
  position: absolute;
  top: -3px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);

  width: 25px;
  height: 25px;
  border-radius: 50%;

  display: grid;
  place-items: center;

  background: var(--blue);
  color: white;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.step-icon {
  width: 58px;
  height: 58px;
  margin: 0 auto 12px;

  display: grid;
  place-items: center;

  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #edf7ff;

  font-size: 24px;
  color: var(--blue);
}

.process-step h3 {
  margin: 0 0 5px;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--navy);
}

.process-step p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 10px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  color: #728497;
}

.process-arrow {
  color: #9cb0c1;
  font-size: 25px;
  margin-top: 27px;
}

.empty-state {
  height: 190px;

  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-direction: column;

  text-align: center;
}

.empty-icon {
  width: 58px;
  height: 58px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;

  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #eef7fd;

  font-size: 25px;
  color: #708ba2;
}

.empty-state h3 {
  margin: 13px 0 5px;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--navy);
}

.empty-state p {
  max-width: 230px;
  margin: 0;

  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: #728497;
}

/* FOOTER */

.site-footer {
  min-height: 77px;

  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;

  padding: 13px 70px;

  border-top: 1px solid #dce4e9;
  background: #fff;

  font-size: 11px;
}

.footer-brand {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
}

.footer-brand strong {
  font-size: 21px;
  color: var(--navy);
}

.footer-brand span,
.footer-brand small {
  color: #667b8e;
}

.footer-links {
  display: flex;
  gap: 16px;
  color: #667b8e;
}

.powered {
  color: #667b8e;
}

/* AUTH PAGES */

.auth-page {
  min-height: 100vh;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #eef6fc;
}

.auth-topbar {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 3;

  min-height: 95px;

  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;

  padding: 25px 72px;
}

.auth-topbar .government-brand {
  color: #304a61;
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.auth-topbar a {
  color: #0871b9;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.auth-layout,
.registration-layout {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;

  width: min(calc(100% - 144px), 1400px);
  margin: 0 auto;

  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 490px 300px;
  gap: 55px;
  align-items: center;
}

.auth-marketing h1,
.registration-marketing h1 {
  margin: 0;

  color: var(--navy);
  font-size: 46px;
  line-height: 1.08;
  letter-spacing: -1px;
}

.orange-line {
  width: 68px;
  height: 3px;
  margin: 18px 0;

  background: var(--orange);
}

.auth-marketing p,
.registration-marketing p {
  font-size: 17px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: #60758a;
}

.auth-marketing blockquote,
.registration-marketing blockquote {
  margin: 245px 0 0;
  color: white;
  font-size: 17px;
  font-style: italic;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.auth-card,
.registration-card {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.98);
  border-radius: 13px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
  padding: 43px 45px;
}

.auth-brand {
  text-align: center;
}

.auth-brand strong {
  display: block;
  font-size: 39px;
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: -1px;
  color: var(--navy);
}

.auth-brand span {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 12px;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.4;
  color: #29445c;
}

.auth-card h2,
.registration-card h2 {
  margin: 30px 0 5px;
  color: var(--navy);
  font-size: 22px;
}

.auth-subtitle {
  margin: 0 0 24px;
  color: #64798c;
}

.auth-card form label,
.registration-card form label {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 7px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #203f59;
}

.input-with-icon {
  height: 43px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;

  border: 1px solid #cbd7e0;
  border-radius: 5px;
  background: white;
}

.input-with-icon span {
  padding-left: 13px;
  color: #75899a;
}

.input-with-icon input {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  height: 100%;

  border: 0;
  outline: 0;
  padding: 0 12px;

  color: var(--text);
}

.input-with-icon button {
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: #6d8294;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 0 12px;
}

.form-options {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin: 17px 0 22px;
  font-size: 13px;
}

.checkbox-label {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  margin: 0 !important;
}

.checkbox-label input {
  width: 17px;
  height: 17px;
}

.form-options a {
  color: #0871b9;
}

.auth-submit {
  width: 100%;
  height: 49px;
}

.or-divider {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 15px;
  margin: 24px 0;
  color: #8a9aaa;
  font-size: 12px;
}

.or-divider::before,
.or-divider::after {
  content: "";
  height: 1px;
  flex: 1;
  background: #d8e0e6;
}

.register-prompt {
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 13px;
}

.register-prompt a {
  color: #0871b9;
  text-decoration: underline;
}

.secure-note {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  align-items: center;
  margin-top: 30px;
  color: #708496;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.secure-icon {
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  background: #718aa0;
  color: white;
}

.auth-features,
.registration-features {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 42px;
}

.auth-features article,
.registration-features article {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 52px 1fr;
  gap: 18px;
}

.auth-features article > span,
.registration-features article > span {
  font-size: 31px;
  color: #668097;
}

.auth-features h3,
.registration-features h3 {
  margin: 0 0 7px;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: #60778d;
}

.auth-features p,
.registration-features p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  color: #8293a3;
}

/* REGISTRATION FORM */

.registration-layout {
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 500px 290px;
  align-items: start;
}

.registration-card {
  padding: 26px 35px 24px;
}

.registration-card h2 {
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 22px;
}

.registration-card .auth-subtitle {
  text-align: center;
}

.registration-card form h3 {
  margin: 15px 0 10px;
  color: var(--navy);
  font-size: 14px;
}

.form-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: 14px;
}

.two-columns {
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
}

.three-columns {
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
}

.field {
  position: relative;
  margin-bottom: 9px;
}

.field input,
.field select {
  width: 100%;
  height: 39px;

  border: 1px solid #cbd7e0;
  border-radius: 5px;

  padding: 0 11px;
  outline: none;

  background: white;
  color: #405a70;
  font-size: 12px;
}

.field input:focus,
.field select:focus {
  border-color: var(--blue);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(11,95,150,.10);
}

.registration-card hr {
  border: 0;
  border-top: 1px solid #dce4e9;
  margin: 8px 0 14px;
}

.phone-field > div {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 55px 1fr;

  border: 1px solid #cbd7e0;
  border-radius: 5px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.phone-field > div > span {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  background: #f6f8fa;
  color: #5f7588;
  font-size: 12px;
}

.phone-field input {
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 0;
}

.password-field button {
  position: absolute;
  right: 9px;
  bottom: 7px;

  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: #718597;
}

.terms {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 7px;
  margin: 12px 0 14px !important;
  font-size: 11px !important;
}

.terms input {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
}

.terms a {
  color: #0871b9;
}

.submit-registration {
  width: 100%;
  height: 43px;
}

/* RESPONSIVE */

@media (max-width: 1200px) {
  .site-header {
    padding: 0 35px;
  }

  .main-nav {
    gap: 16px;
  }

  .lower-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .lower-grid > section {
    border-right: 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #dce4ea;
  }

  .auth-layout,
  .registration-layout {
    width: min(calc(100% - 50px), 900px);
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 500px;
  }

  .auth-features,
  .registration-features {
    display: none;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 800px) {
  .site-header {
    height: 68px;
  }

  .main-nav a:not(.login-button),
  .search-button {
    display: none;
  }

  .hero-content {
    padding: 55px 0;
  }

  .hero-side-copy {
    display: none;
  }

  .primary-features,
  .secondary-features {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }

  .feature {
    border-bottom: 1px solid #dbe3e9;
  }

  .auth-layout,
  .registration-layout {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    width: min(calc(100% - 32px), 560px);
    padding-bottom: 30px;
  }

  .auth-marketing,
  .registration-marketing {
    display: none;
  }

  .auth-topbar {
    padding: 18px 20px;
  }

  .registration-card,
  .auth-card {
    padding: 30px 25px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 560px) {
  .page-container {
    width: calc(100% - 32px);
  }

  .hero-copy h1 {
    font-size: 39px;
  }

  .hero-actions {
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .trust-items {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 12px;
  }

  .trust-items > div {
    padding-left: 0;
  }

  .primary-features,
  .secondary-features {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .two-columns,
  .three-columns {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .site-footer {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 14px;
    padding: 20px 25px;
  }

  .footer-links {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
}
```

# 8. IMPORTANT ICON INSTRUCTION

The symbols in the HTML above are only structural placeholders.

For the final implementation, replace them with a consistent professional outline icon library such as **Lucide React**, if the project uses React.

Recommended icons:

```text
FileText
ShieldCheck
Scale
Users
Leaf
BarChart3
Lightbulb
Lock
Bell
ListChecks
ArrowRight
Search
Eye
EyeOff
MapPin
Building2
Mail
Phone
User

```

Do NOT use emoji.

---

# 9. BACKGROUND IMAGE INSTRUCTION

The screenshots contain a government-building visual.

If an appropriate local asset already exists, use it.

If the project has no suitable asset, create/import a visually matching local asset rather than making the screenshot itself the page.

The background should be:

- large
- softly faded
- blue/white washed
- positioned behind content
- readable underneath overlay
- responsive
- not visually dominant

The screenshot itself must never be used as the full-page background.

# 10. REQUIRED FORM BEHAVIOR

## Login

Implement:

```js
const handleLogin = (event) => {
  event.preventDefault();

  if (!email || !password) {
    setError("Please enter your email/username and password.");
    return;
  }

  // Mock successful frontend login
};
```

Password visibility:

```js
const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);

<input
  type={showPassword ? "text" : "password"}
/>
```

## Registration

Validate:

```text
Organization Name       required
Organization Type      required
Registration Number    required
Business Address       required
City                   required
State                  required
PIN Code               valid 6 digits
Full Name              required
Official Email         valid email
Phone                  valid Indian phone
Password               required
Confirm Password       must match
Terms                  required
```
